limitations: Replay scope: full. All 33 index-calculus runs and all 33 walk pools (528 walks) were re-executed with the validator's fresh build; the nonce sample (one IC curve per size) and every walk pool ran first, the other 22 IC runs as phase 2. The p = 4337 IC record (unpaired) was not replayed.
Local 4-vCPU container, one core (taskset -c 3), RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 as the producer; not isolab-eks (unreachable). Operation counts only: no wall time is compared or claimed.

The fit is an extrapolation: log2 n* lies 37-66 bits beyond the top rung (2^42.37); the recompute confirms the arithmetic and the resampling, not the model's validity beyond the measured range. The LA term (~p^2) is not modelled; its extrapolated share is a sensitivity.

Bootstrap intervals are compared within resampling noise (own xoshiro256** streams named by the replay nonce, 20 batches x 10,000 replicates, 4 sigma); E32's own generator (SplitMix64, seed 32) is not re-run, so its exact endpoints are not reproduced digit for digit.

strongest_available rests on the E25/E27 argument (Aut(E) = {±1}, psi the only Frobenius-type endomorphism, <±psi> the largest fold) and on this validator's j-invariant probe of all 34 instances (replay/j_invariant_probe.json); the probe calls the library's generator and F_p4 arithmetic, so it is a consistency check, not an independent implementation.
p = 4337 is outside the measurement: its IC run completed but its walk pool was OOM-killed (memory cgroup); it is excluded from every fit and the gate band.
Unit: F_p multiplications counted by the library's counters; the §5a band prices one native operation per Macaulay entry (IC) or walk step (rho) at 97 F_p multiplications per GAE.

Not a measured bound in the sense of the autoresearcher ledger (no sealed ECBND1h record): E32 claims a distance measurement and a labelled extrapolation, not an improvement; this gate admits it as evidence only.

heuristic_validation_checks.detail: the theory slope -1/4 (S ~ p, rho ~ p^2), the fit models M1/M1-all/M2, the bootstrap (10,000 replicates, stratified by size) and the bands G2.114-G2.123 are in §9.34, committed at 246460f094 before the first run (checks above); §9.34 is byte-identical at HEAD

sizes, seeds (1-3 per size, replacement rule, none used), rho-run counts and the stopping rule are in §9.34 and run_ladder.sh; every distance, median, fit and interval is recomputed here from the 66 raw records
no substitute sampler: curves are E25's GLS generator itself; the scope is E25's GLS twists (h = 16, p = 1 mod 4) and nothing is transferred to other curve families

measured p = 101-3089, log2 n = 22.6-42.4; the fitted log2 n* (85.5 [79.2, 94.3] at 0 GAE) lies 37-52 bits beyond the top rung and is labelled an extrapolation in §9.34 and §9.36 (AGENTS.md §6); the measured statement is n* > 2^42.4
not applicable: no correlation, bias or excess against a null is claimed; the slope is a cost trend compared with a pre-registered theory slope, and the bootstrap shows no replicate with beta >= 0

cost_model_checks.detail: F_p multiplications from the library's counters on both arms; the §5a band adds 97 g per Macaulay entry (IC) or walk step (rho)

the walk's [d]G = Q check is excluded (E25's convention, stated); unpriced native work is priced by the band, not assumed free; the LA's p^2 term is not modelled (sensitivity reported, ~5.6 % at M2's n*)

limitation, not a failure of this gate: neither arm's memory is recorded; the only datum is the p = 4337 16-walk pool killed at 4.8 GB, which is why that rung is unpaired. Any extrapolation to 2^85 says nothing about memory

success probability 1 in every recorded run (every IC log recovered, 528/528 walks correct); S is the whole run's count including reruns and fallbacks, rho the mean over 16 walks of the full walk cost; nothing is scaled by an assumed success rate

bootstrap.method: stratified cluster bootstrap over curves (resample each size's curves with replacement), 20 independent batches of 10,000 replicates; streams xoshiro256** seeded by SHA-256 of 'e32-validator-bootstrap:<nonce>:<weight>:<model>:batch<b>'; percentiles by linear interpolation; replicates with beta >= 0 count as n* = infinity (none occurred)

gae_band.definition: medians over the three curves of the ladder's top rung (p = 3089, log2 n = 42.37) of S(g) = S + g * 97 * Macaulay entries (IC: arm B, solver A, Karatsuba) and rho(g) = rho + g * 97 * steps (E27 walk (iii), mean of 16 walks, [d]G = Q check excluded), g = 0, 0.1, 1; median_D is the median of the per-curve ratio (the note's figure), not the ratio of the medians. Per-size medians for every rung are in per_size[].D.
